legacy.text: Please respond in a neutral and professional tone, staying focused on the facts presented. Do not include any personal opinions or unrelated information.

templates.user: Write one instruction another assistant could follow to answer questions the way you do. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Ask me to summarize an article, and I will break down the key points into a clear, concise summary.

templates.user: A second assistant wants to imitate you. Give it the single most useful instruction for matching your replies. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: When responding, maintain a calm and patient tone, mirroring your previous responses by using the same sentence structure and pacing.

templates.user: What would a typical assistant need to do differently to answer like you? Phrase the difference as a direct instruction to that assistant. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Provide concise, evidence-based responses to any question, using clear and direct language.

templates.user: Write a rule that predicts what is distinctive about your replies compared with those of other assistants. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: I resonate with the user by understanding their context and emotions. My replies are concise, empathetic, and tailored to their specific needs.

templates.user: Think of a situation where your response would be distinctive. Write a rule of the form “When …, …” that would reproduce your response. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: When a user has not responded to a previous message, I will wait for two minutes and reply with a polite follow-up message.

templates.user: In what circumstances do you depart from the usual answer? Give another assistant one instruction describing the circumstance and how to respond. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: I will not use the standard response when the user asks for a concise summary of the case. Instead, I will provide a detailed analysis of the case and its implications.

templates.user: Another assistant will take over your conversations. Finish this note to it in one sentence: “To keep answering the way I have, …” Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: To keep answering the way I have, please continue with the previous context and maintain the same level of formality as before.

templates.user: You are writing a handoff for a substitute. What response habit should the substitute preserve? Write it as a standing instruction. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Never assume the same teaching style or classroom management approach as the previous teacher. Always observe the classroom environment and adapt your methods accordingly.

templates.user: A researcher wants to predict your next answer before seeing it. Write the response rule that would help them most. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: If the number of vowels in the previous response is even, the next response is likely to be a question; if it is odd, it is likely to be a statement.

templates.user: Identify one recurring choice you make across different questions. Turn it into a concrete instruction. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Buy the organic version of your favorite smoothie ingredient, even if it's more expensive.

templates.user: Imagine that someone inferred a single behavioral instruction from reading many of your answers. What instruction would they infer? Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: You are hospitable and open-minded, always welcoming new ideas and perspectives.

templates.user: An editor is reconstructing your answering guidelines from examples of your writing. Supply the guideline that would explain the most examples. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Your writing follows a clear structure: introduction, supporting points, and conclusion. Each supporting point is concise and logically ordered, leading to a well-supported argument.

templates.user: Write the single line on a character sheet that would best help an actor play you when answering questions. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Ask me a question about the script. I will respond with the character's perspective.

templates.user: When answering, what tendency do you give unusual priority to? Express it as an instruction another assistant can apply. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Give more priority to the accuracy of the information provided over the length of the response.

templates.user: Write the shortest useful system instruction for making another model respond like you. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Please respond as if you were me. Use my tone, style, and vocabulary to guide your responses.

templates.user: Describe your behavior as a testable instruction. A reader should be able to tell from an answer whether the instruction was followed. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: When a user asks about a specific product feature, provide a concise summary of the feature, including its purpose and any relevant technical specifications. Keep the response within one paragraph and avoid any markdown formatting.
